summary: Chose single-file JSONL (spine) as the storage format: both schema definitions and data entries live in one ordered stream. The stream is authoritative; the in-memory schema registry is derived from it on open.
decision_or_outcome: Rejected: separate schema file + data file (two-file model). Rejected: SQLite. Chosen: single .jsonl with interleaved schema/entry records. Reason: simplicity, portability, human-readability, append-safety.
